transcript: Speaker A (Girl): Bhaiya, pani puri kitna hai? [Bhaiya, how much is the pani puri?] Speaker B (Vendor): 20 rupees. Speaker A: Two plate. Aiyyo, ivanukku vera puriyadhe... [Oh no, he won't understand, how do I explain?] Enakku kaaram othukkadhu, sweet okay. [I can't handle spicy, sweet is okay.] Speaker C (Customer): Madam, don't worry. I'll help you. Bhaiya, madam ko do plate pani puri... [Bhaiya, two plates of pani puri for madam...] Speaker B: Sir, why are you killing Hindi like this? Madam, you know English right? Speaker A: Please don't add spice, just add sweet sauce. Speaker B: Okay madam. Speaker A: Bhaiya, you speak super English! Where did you learn it? Speaker B: I learned English through SpeakX app to communicate with customers. SpeakX is an AI-based English speaking app where you can practice in your regional language and get corrected by AI teachers. Just 10-15 minutes daily for 2 weeks is enough. Speaker A: Is it expensive? Speaker B: No, 7-day trial for just 2 rupees. Speaker A: Bro, download SpeakX now and improve your English! Speaker B: Download SpeakX app right away! Voiceover: SpeakX app is available on Play Store and App Store. Download now.

summary: A customer struggles to order pani puri in Hindi, but the vendor surprises her by speaking fluent English. He explains he learned English using the SpeakX app to communicate better with customers. The ad promotes SpeakX's AI-based learning features and a 2-rupee trial, urging viewers to download the app.
